article.opening: Ambition stops looking impressive when the person holding everything together cannot take a day off. Saturn in Capricorn exposes the plans that only work because someone remembers every deadline, catches every mistake, and stays late to make up the difference.
article.tension: A project can win praise while one person sends corrections at midnight, covers a vacant role, and logs in on vacation. The same problem can show up at home: a household looks organized because the same person remembers every appointment, payment, and form. When that person stops doing all of it, deadlines slip, messages go unanswered, and everyone discovers how much of the plan depended on work nobody else was prepared to do.
article.development: Being needed can feel like proof of competence until every problem belongs to the same person. We take the task back when someone else does it differently, answer messages during dinner, and postpone rest so the work stays on schedule. The deadline gets met, but the knowledge and responsibility stay in one set of hands.
article.close: Work that holds its value over time cannot depend on one person giving up every evening, weekend, and day off.
